name: Gemma-4-31B-it
blurb: A 60-layer decoder with a 5:1 sliding/full attention pattern, a different head geometry and a different rope per layer type, and a sandwich of four RMSNorms per layer. Images arrive as exactly 280 pooled soft tokens scattered into the text stream.
shape_note: 60 layers · hidden 5376 · 32 Q heads · sliding layers: head_dim 256, 16 KV heads, window 1024 · full layers: head_dim 512, 4 KV heads, V = K · vocab 262144, tied · one image = 280 soft tokens.
